data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'fakkaha' which means 'knowledgeable' or 'possessing knowledge'. In Islamic tradition, Fakiha is a name given to a woman who has acquired extensive knowledge in various fields, particularly in the study of the Quran and Hadith. The name Fakiha carries the meaning “Knowledgeable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fakiha usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledgeable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
